qen: And He sent against them birds in flocks
note: Describes the birds in Sura 105; it has no agreed singular.

qen: And when his Lord tested Abraham with words
with goblets and jugs and a cup
note: In the Qur'an only the plural is used, for the serving jugs of Paradise.

qen: Bow down to Adam, so they bowed, except Iblis, who refused
note: The proper name of the devil, who refused to bow to Adam.

qen: he warned his people at al-Ahqaf
note: Al-Ahqaf: the dune country of the people of Aad, and the title of Sura 46; singular حِقْف.

qen: who will come after me, whose name is Ahmad
note: In 61:6 Jesus foretells a messenger of this name; literally 'most praiseworthy'; a common given name.

qen: Idris; he was a truthful man and a prophet
note: Often identified with the biblical Enoch.

qen: And He taught Adam the names, all of them
Iram of the pillars
Abraham said to his father Azar
note: Commentators differ on whether he was Abraham's father or uncle.

qen: And We gave him the good news of Isaac, a prophet
O Children of Israel
note: Banu Isra'il, 'the Children of Israel', are the descendants of Jacob.

qen: Ishmael; he was true to his promise
and on the Heights are men
note: Al-A'raf: the elevated place between Paradise and Hell in 7:46, and the title of Sura 7.

qen: They said: now you have brought the truth
Have you considered al-Lat and al-Uzza?
note: The article is part of the name.

qen: Have you considered al-Lat and al-Uzza?
note: The article is part of the name.

qen: and Elijah, each of them among the righteous
and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel
note: A loan from Greek; in the Qur'an it is the revelation given to Jesus.

qen: the people of the thicket were wrongdoers
note: Ashab al-Ayka, 'the people of the thicket', are the people of Shuayb in 15:78.

qen: and Job, when he called upon his Lord
upon the two angels in Babylon
God had already given you victory at Badr
note: A place of wells southwest of Medina; the word also means a full moon.

qen: The first house set up for people is the one at Bakkah
note: Used once, for the site of the Kaaba.

en: Tubba' (title of the kings of Himyar)
qen: or the people of Tubba'
note: A title of the ancient Himyarite kings of Yemen.

qen: and He sent down the Torah and the Gospel
note: A loan from Hebrew; in the Qur'an it is the revelation given to Moses.

qen: And to Thamud We sent their brother Salih
and David killed Goliath

Hell is enough for him, and what an evil resting place
note: The usual name of Hell in the Qur'an; a loan from Hebrew Gehinnom.

qen: and it settled on al-Judi
note: The mountain where the ark came to rest; traditionally placed in the Kurdish highlands.

qen: and on the day of Hunayn, when your great numbers pleased you

note: In the Qur'an, the devoted followers of Jesus; in general, a close and loyal follower.

qen: We gave David a favour from Us
The month of Ramadan, in which
The Romans have been defeated
note: The Byzantine Romans; Sura 30 is named after them.

qen: and carpets spread out
note: Singular زِرْبِيَّة.

qen: and Zechariah took charge of her
a cup whose mixture is ginger

qen: and the Samiri led them astray
note: In Ta-Ha 20:85 the man who led the Israelites to the golden calf; in modern Arabic, a Samaritan.

qen: I have come to you from Saba with sure news
note: The ancient kingdom of Yemen ruled by the queen who met Solomon; also Sura 34.

qen: their garments will be of tar
note: Plural of سِرْبال; in the Qur'an also coats of mail (16:81).

qen: its enclosure has surrounded them
note: In 18:29 the walls of the Fire; in modern usage, the large tent set up for funerals and events.

qen: Taste the touch of Saqar
a spring there called Salsabil
note: Also used in Arabic for sweet, smoothly flowing water.

qen: And We granted Solomon to David, an excellent servant
from Mount Sinai

note: A second name for Sinai, as in the oath of Sura 95.

qen: And to Midian We sent their brother Shuayb
the Jews, the Christians and the Sabians

qen: Indeed Safa and Marwa
note: One of two hills at the Kaaba between which pilgrims walk; the word also means a smooth rock.

qen: whoever rejects false gods and believes in God
note: In the Qur'an, any false deity or power worshipped instead of God; in modern usage, a tyrant.

qen: God has sent Talut to you as king

note: The Qur'an's mighty ancient people who rejected the prophet Hud.

qen: in the gardens of Eden
note: Jannat Adn, the gardens of Eden; also the name of a city in Yemen (Aden).

qen: when you pour out from Arafat, remember God
note: The place where pilgrims stand on the ninth of Dhu al-Hijja.

qen: so We sent upon them the flood of the dam
note: Usually taken as the great Marib dam; some commentators read it as 'violent'.

qen: The Jews said, Uzayr is the son of God
note: Usually identified with the biblical Ezra.

qen: said the wife of Imran
the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary
the gardens of Paradise
note: A loan from Persian or Greek; in the Qur'an the highest level of Paradise.

qen: the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with terrible torment
note: In the Qur'an it is the name of the ruler in Moses's story; in Arabic it also means a tyrant.

qen: Qarun was one of the people of Moses
note: Proverbial for great wealth; often identified with the biblical Korah.

qen: For the familiarity of the Quraysh
that among them are priests and monks
a cup whose mixture is camphor

in Babylon, Harut and Marut
Muhammad is only a messenger
note: Literally 'highly praised'; also a very common given name.

qen: And to Midian We sent their brother Shuayb
Indeed Safa and Marwa
note: The second of the two hills of the sa'y; the word also means a flint stone.

qen: O Mary, God gives you good news
his name is the Messiah, Jesus
note: In the Qur'an al-Masih is a title of Jesus; in modern Arabic it also means Christ.

qen: in the valley of Mecca
and Manat, the third, the other
And when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights
and Gabriel and Michael
note: The Qur'an spells it ميكال; the usual modern spelling is ميكائيل.

qen: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian
note: The Qur'an mostly uses the plural النَّصارى; in modern usage مَسيحِيّ is the neutral word.

qen: We sent Noah to his people
in Babylon, Harut and Marut
Aaron, my brother
And Pharaoh said, O Haman

except those who were Jews or Christians
note: Used in 2:111, 2:135 and 2:140 for the Jews; modern Arabic uses يَهود.

qen: Far, far is what you are promised
note: An exclamation of remoteness, said of something far-fetched or impossible.

qen: Gog and Magog are corrupters on the earth
note: With مَأْجُوج, a destructive people walled in by Dhul-Qarnayn.

qen: Peace be upon Il-Yasin
note: In 37:130 often understood as another form of the name Elijah; Sura 36 is called Ya-Sin.

qen: as if they were rubies and coral

qen: and Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah, and Lot
note: Always written with the article, الْيَسَع.

qen: when death came to Jacob
nor Yaghuth, nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr

and fruit and pasture
note: Qur'anic word for grazing plants, once in 80:31; classical and rare today.

qen: abiding therein forever

note: With a negative it means never; with a positive verb, forever.
Most often in السِّجْن المُؤَبَّد, life imprisonment.
Also a hypodermic needle or an injection.

qen: when he fled to the laden ship
note: Classically said of a runaway slave; in 37:140 of Yunus.
Classically said of a runaway slave.

qen: flocks of birds
note: Only in 105:3; no singular is known, so it is learned as a plural.

qen: Do they not look at the camels
note: Takes feminine agreement; a single camel is جَمَل or ناقة.

qen: our father is clearly in error
note: Dual أَبَوان means the parents; the long forms أَبو and أَبي appear in construct, as in أَبو بَكر.

qen: and let no scribe refuse to write
note: Often takes أَنْ: أَبَى أَنْ يَفْعَلَ, he refused to do.
Typically in نَفْس أَبِيَّة, a proud spirit that does not submit.

qen: and that the Hour is coming, there is no doubt about it
note: Bare form shown; indefinite آتٍ, as in الأُسبوع الآتي, next week.

qen: and give the alms-tax
note: Literary; everyday Arabic uses أَعْطَى. The passive أُوتِيَ means was given.

qen: and giving to relatives

note: Said of something that becomes feasible or results from something else.

qen: those who establish prayer and give the alms-tax
indeed His promise is sure to come
note: Literally something that is come to; rare outside the Qur'an.

qen: and from their wool, fur and hair, furnishings and goods
or a trace of knowledge
note: Qur'anic: a surviving relic of earlier knowledge.

qen: And We sent after their footsteps
note: The plural آثار also means antiquities, as in عِلم الآثار, archaeology.

qen: he said, this is nothing but magic handed down
note: The Qur'an has only the passive يُؤْثَرُ, handed down; the active verb is classical and rare.
Takes فِي: أَثَّرَ فِيهِ, it affected him.

qen: Allah has indeed preferred you over us
note: Takes عَلَى for what is put second.
Takes بِ: اِسْتَأْثَرَ بِالسُّلْطَةِ.
Takes بِ: تَأَثَّرَ بِهِ, he was influenced by it.
Of sayings and customs passed down, as in قَوْل مَأْثُور.

qen: bitter fruit, tamarisk, and a little lote-tree
whoever does that will meet a penalty
note: Qur'anic, 25:68; read as the recompense for sin.

qen: you back one another against them in sin and aggression
then his heart is sinful
Allah does not love any sinful ingrate
note: Intensive: habitually sinful.

qen: no idle talk therein and no sinful speech
note: In 52:23, talk that makes others sin or charges them with sin.

qen: and this one salty and bitter
note: Qur'anic: said of salt water, set against sweet water.
Of fire and, figuratively, of conflict or emotions.

qen: We will give them a great reward
note: In the Qur'an mostly God's reward; in modern usage the plural أُجُور means wages and fees.

en: to reward; to work for pay
qen: that you work for me for eight years
note: In 28:27 تَأْجُرَنِي means you work for me for hire; the active verb is classical, and modern Arabic uses أَجَّرَ and اِسْتَأْجَرَ.
Pay for a service or a rental, such as a taxi fare.
Of someone paid to act, a hireling; in religious usage also rewarded by God.

qen: Because of that
note: Used only in مِنْ أَجْلِ and لِأَجْلِ, for the sake of, because of.

qen: For every nation there is a term, and when their term comes
note: Also a deadline or the hour of death; أَجَل مُسَمًّى is a fixed term.
Formal word of agreement; unrelated in sense to أَجَل, term.
Often in عاجِلاً أَو آجِلاً, sooner or later.

qen: by Allah's leave, a decree with a fixed term

note: As in أُحَادِيّ الجانِب, unilateral.

qen: it is one of the greatest (of calamities)
note: Feminine of أَحَد; always followed by a genitive, as in إِحْدَى الطالِبات, one of the students.

qen: you wronged yourselves by taking the calf
note: Common in اِتِّخَاذ قَرَار, making a decision, and اِتِّخَاذ إِجْرَاءَات, taking measures.

qen: there is no creature but He holds it by its forelock
Allah will not hold you to account for idle talk in your oaths
note: Takes بِ for the fault: آخَذَهُ بِذَنْبِهِ, he held him to account for his fault.

qen: and for their taking usury, though they were forbidden it
and He seized them with a mounting seizure

note: The plural often means criticisms, as in مَآخِذ عَلَى, objections to.
مَأْخُوذ بِ means struck by, spellbound by.

qen: not committing fornication nor taking secret lovers

note: As in الإِجْرَاءَات المُتَّخَذَة, the measures taken.

qen: And Allah will never delay a soul
and in the Hereafter they are certain
note: Usually with the article, الآخِرَة; as an adjective it is the feminine of آخِر, last.
Feminine أَخِيرَة; the adverb أَخِيرًا (finally) is already in the bank.

qen: when their term comes they cannot delay it by an hour
note: Rare today; paired with اِسْتَقْدَمَ, to advance, in the Qur'an.

qen: and whoever delays, there is no sin on him

note: Of a ship, army or vehicle; also the buttocks.

qen: and We know those who come later
And to Ad, their brother Hud
note: The plural إِخْوَة means brothers or siblings; إِخْوَان is used for brothers in a wider sense, such as comrades.
Plural of أَدَب (in the bank as الأَدَب); كُلِّيَّة الآدَاب is the faculty of arts.
Also moral, as in دَعْم أَدَبِيّ, moral support.
Feminine أَدِيبَة; also an adjective, cultured, refined.

qen: You have brought something monstrous
note: Qur'anic and rare; said of an outrageous claim or deed.

qen: a fair following-up, and payment to him with kindness
note: Also the performance of a task, or how well something works.

qen: let the one who was entrusted discharge his trust
note: Also to lead to: أَدَّى إِلَى, it led to.
As in تَأْدِيَة الواجِب, doing one's duty.
Indefinite مُؤَدٍّ, as in مُؤَدٍّ إِلَى, leading to.

qen: and an announcement from Allah and His Messenger
except by Allah's permission
note: Also a permit or leave; the particle إِذَنْ (then, therefore) is a different word.

qen: then a herald will announce among them
then say: I have announced to you all alike
and the ear for the ear
note: In 9:61 هُوَ أُذُنٌ means he is all ear, too ready to listen.

qen: except for whomever the Merciful permits
note: Takes لِ for the person: أَذِنَ لَهُ. In 2:279 the imperative فَأْذَنُوا means take notice.

qen: Those who believe in Allah and the Last Day do not ask your leave
And when your Lord declared He would send against them
note: Qur'anic and rare; said of a solemn declaration.

qen: then a herald called out: O caravan
note: In 7:44 and 12:70 any herald; today the man who gives the call to prayer.
In Egypt also the official who registers marriages.

qen: Indeed those who harm Allah and His Messenger
ill or has an ailment in his head

Indefinite مُؤْذٍ, as in حَيَوَان مُؤْذٍ, a harmful animal.
Mostly in إِرْبًا إِرْبًا, limb by limb, to pieces.

qen: or male attendants with no desire among men
note: Qur'anic, in أُولِي الإِرْبَة, men who have no sexual need of women.
Literary.

qen: and I have other uses for it
note: Plural of مَأْرَب; in 20:18 the other uses of Moses' staff.
Often in مَآرِب شَخْصِيَّة, personal ends.
أَرَّخَ لِـ means to write the history of.
Of a letter or document that carries a date.

qen: or has an ailment in his head
Indeed God is Kind and Merciful to the people

note: Takes بِ for the person pitied, as in رَأَفَ بِهِ.

qen: and let no pity for the two of them seize you

en: to deem, to be of the opinion

qen: and if We willed, We would have shown them to you
note: Not to be confused with أَرَى, I see, which is form I.

qen: and when the two groups came in sight of each other
note: In 8:48 the two armies sighted each other; in modern usage it also means to appear or seem to someone.

qen: All praise is for God, Lord of the worlds
note: With the article, الرَّبّ, it means God; in construct it can be an owner or head, as in رَبّ الأُسْرة, head of the family.

qen: be devoted to the Lord
note: In 3:79 the plural describes people wholly devoted to God and to teaching His Book.

qen: and your stepdaughters who are in your care

qen: so their trade did not profit

en: to wait, to lie in wait
qen: Divorced women shall wait by themselves
note: Often with بِ: to wait for or watch for an outcome, as in 9:52; in modern usage, to lurk.

qen: a waiting of four months
so wait; we are waiting with you

en: to stand guard, to be stationed
qen: Be patient, outlast, stand guard, and fear God

note: Used as a noun, for example a hyperlink.

qen: and of tethered horses
note: In 8:60 it is the keeping of horses tethered ready for war; a ribat is also a fortified frontier post, and today the word can mean a bandage or tie.

qen: and to strengthen your hearts
note: The idiom رَبَطَ عَلى قَلْبِهِ, lit. to bind his heart, means to give it calm and strength.

qen: the testimony of each of them is four testimonies by God

note: Used with يَوْم, as in يَوْم الأَرْبِعاء.

three, the fourth of them their dog
by twos, threes and fours
then you get a quarter of what they leave

note: Both the adjective square and the noun a square.

qen: God destroys usury and makes charities grow
note: In 16:92 it means to be more numerous than; today أَرْبى عَلى means to exceed.

qen: rising foam
so He seized them with an ever-growing seizure
note: In 69:10 it is an adjective, ever growing or ever worse; as a noun it is a rise of ground.

qen: so that it may grow in people's wealth

note: Usually with عَلى: to follow from, to result from something.

qen: tomorrow, so that he may run free and play
note: Of animals grazing at will and, as in 12:12, of carefree enjoyment.

qen: the heavens and the earth were joined as one mass

qen: and We arranged it in a measured way
note: The slow, clearly articulated way of reciting the Qur'an, tajwid style.

qen: and recite the Qur'an slowly and distinctly

qen: when the earth is violently shaken

qen: the earth, with a violent shaking
override: corpus maps رَجًّا (56:4) to ر-ج-و; it is the masdar of رَجَّ, root ر-ج-ج

qen: so We sent down on those who did wrong a scourge from heaven
note: In 74:5 الرُّجْز, also read الرِّجْز, is taken to mean filth or idols to be avoided.

qen: wine, gambling, idols and divining arrows are an abomination from Satan's handiwork

en: to give back, to send back

qen: that the two may return to each other
note: In 2:230 a divorced couple taking each other back; in modern usage, to retreat or decline.

qen: and that to Him they will return
that is a distant return

qen: Indeed, to your Lord is the return
to God is your return, all of you
note: In scripture it is the final return to God; today also a reference work or authority.

qen: the day the quaking one quakes
note: In 79:6 the feminine الرَّاجِفَة is the first blast of the Trumpet, which makes everything quake.

qen: the day the earth and the mountains quake
so the quake seized them
and those who spread rumors in the city

en: to dismount, to go on foot

qen: two men, or one man and two women
with your horsemen and your foot soldiers
note: In 17:64 a collective for troops on foot, set against the cavalry (خَيْل).

qen: and wipe your heads and your feet up to the ankles

note: From the phrase راجِمة صَواريخ, a multiple rocket launcher.

qen: and if it were not for your clan, we would have stoned you
guessing at the unseen
note: In 18:22 it means conjecture, lit. throwing at the unseen; the plural رُجوم in 67:5 means missiles hurled at devils.

qen: for you are accursed
note: In the set phrase الشَّيْطان الرَّجيم, lit. the stoned or cast-out Satan.

qen: you will surely be among those stoned

note: The Qur'anic variant of أَرْجَأَ, which is the usual modern form.

qen: and hope for His mercy
and the angels will be at its sides
note: Mostly met in the plural, as in فِي أَرْجاء البِلاد, throughout the country.

qen: you were among us a man of promise before this
and others are left waiting for God's decree

note: Common in رَحابَة الصَّدْر, open-mindedness.

en: to be spacious, to be wide
qen: and the earth closed in on you despite its vastness

note: In 83:25 the sealed choice wine of Paradise; in modern usage, the nectar of flowers.

qen: put their goods in their saddlebags
their accustomed journey of winter and summer
were it not that you think me senile
note: In 12:94 it means to accuse someone of weak-mindedness; in modern usage, to refute an argument or claim.

qen: both having spreading branches
note: Plural of فَنَن (branch); it is also a plural of فَنّ (kind, art).
Usually followed by في, as in تَفَنَّنَ في الطَّبْخ, to show flair in cooking.
As a noun it also means a technician.
Used with في or من أجل: تَفانَى في عَمَلِه, he gave himself wholly to his work.
Written تَفانٍ when indefinite.
Written فانٍ when indefinite; it occurs in Qur'an 55:26, where everyone on earth is described as perishing.

en: to perish, to come to an end

note: In grammar, أَداةُ اِسْتِفْهام is an interrogative particle.
Usually followed by عن: to ask for clarification about something.

qen: and We gave Solomon understanding of it
you do not see any inconsistency in the creation of the Most Merciful
note: In 67:3 it means a flaw or lack of harmony in creation.

en: to be missed, to slip by
qen: so that you would not grieve over what you missed
then there is no escape
note: Modern usage: loss or missing of an opportunity, as in فَوْتُ الفُرْصة.

qen: On the Day We gather from every nation a troop

en: to boil over, to gush forth
qen: they hear a roar from it as it boils
and they come at you at once
note: مِن فَوْرِهِم means at once, in their rush; فَوْرًا is the common adverb immediately.

qen: and it is they who are the successful
whoever is kept away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has indeed succeeded
and that is the great triumph

note: Rare outside the Qur'an; in 78:31 it is the attainment of salvation.

qen: do not think them safe from the punishment
note: In 3:188 it means a place of escape or safety; in modern usage, a waterless desert.

qen: and I entrust my affair to God

note: As a noun it means an anarchist.

en: to wake up, to come to
note: Occurs once in the Qur'an (7:143), of Moses coming to after he fell down senseless.
Usually followed by على: to outdo someone.
Occurs once in the Qur'an (38:15) for a brief respite; the vowelling فُواق is the modern word for hiccup.
Occurs once in the Qur'an (2:61), in the list of foods the Israelites asked for; some commentators read it as wheat or grain.

qen: hatred has already shown from their mouths
note: Plural of فَم, the everyday word for mouth.
Usually followed by ب: تَفَوَّهَ بِكَلِمة, he uttered a word.
Used for the opening of a gun, a volcano, a tunnel or a bottle.

qen: and what God has given as spoils
note: Said of booty taken without fighting, which is called الفَيْء.

qen: whose shadows incline
note: Usually said of shade shifting or being sought, as in تَفَيَّأَ الظِّلَّ.
In the Qur'an (for example 8:19) it usually means a fighting band or host; in modern usage, a category or class.

qen: then if they return, God is Forgiving and Merciful

note: Shade that shifts in the afternoon; in law, booty taken without battle.
Usually followed by من.
Also means interest on money (فَوائِد بَنْكِيّة).

qen: and when you pour out from Arafat
note: In 2:198 it describes the pilgrims streaming out of Arafat; in modern usage أَفاضَ في الحَديث means to expand on a topic.

qen: you see their eyes overflowing with tears
how your Lord dealt with the people of the elephant

en: to find ugly, to disapprove of
to be ugly, to be vile

note: قَبَّحَهُ اللهُ is a curse meaning may God make him hideous.

qen: they will be among the despised
note: Said of Pharaoh's people, cast out and made loathsome on the Day of Resurrection.

qen: then He caused him to die and gave him a grave
and do not stand at his grave
until you visit the graveyards
note: In the Qur'an it occurs only as the plural مَقابِر.

qen: wait for us that we may take some of your light
note: In 57:13 it is to take a share of light, as one takes a flame; in modern usage, to quote.

qen: perhaps I can bring you a brand from it

note: Also figurative: to feel oppressed or tense.

qen: and God withholds and extends
note: Also used for receiving money and for arresting someone.

qen: then We draw it back to Us, an easy drawing back
note: Modern usage: taking payment or arresting, as in إِيصال قَبْض, a receipt.

qen: so I took a handful from the trace
then pledges taken in hand

note: Used for popularity or demand, as in إِقْبال على الشِّراء.

qen: they said, turning toward them, What is it you are missing?
note: Often followed by على: to turn to, to take up.

en: to meet, to face each other

qen: so her Lord accepted her with a gracious acceptance
and Acceptor of repentance
note: In modern usage it also means next (as in السَّنة القابِلة) or capable of (قابِل لـ).

qen: which they have no power to face
note: مِن قِبَلِ is the common phrase for on the part of or by; لا قِبَلَ لَهُ بِـ means he has no power to face it.

qen: his shirt is torn from the front
note: In 6:111 قُبُلًا is read as face to face or in groups.

qen: what has turned them from their direction of prayer
he sees you, he and his tribe
note: مِن قَبيلِ is a common phrase meaning in the category of.

qen: and made you peoples and tribes so that you might know one another
as brothers on couches, facing one another
as a cloud approaching their valleys
note: Also a noun meaning a receiver, as in a radio receiver; not the same word as مُسْتَقْبَل, the future.
Often a preposition or noun, as in مُقابِلَ أَجْر, for a fee.

qen: they are neither wasteful nor stingy
note: Usually said of spending: to be tight-fisted with money or provisions.

qen: and no gloom covers their faces
note: In 10:26 it is the dark dust or gloom of shame that covers a face; the word is rare today.

en: to be stingy with, to ration
note: Usually followed by على: قَتَّرَ على عِيالِه, he was stingy with his family.

qen: gloom will cover them
note: In 80:41 it is the darkness that covers the faces of the wicked; the word is rare today.

qen: and man has always been stingy
and on the one of limited means, according to his means
had God willed, those after them would not have fought one another
and be slain outright
and fight in the cause of God

note: As an adjective it means deadly.

qen: fighting has been prescribed for you
so kill yourselves
that they be killed or crucified
and persecution is worse than killing
retaliation is prescribed for you in cases of the slain
note: In the Qur'an only the plural قَتْلى occurs.
The place where someone is killed, or a vital spot where a blow is fatal.

qen: of its herbs and its cucumbers
but he has not attempted the steep path
note: In 90:11 it means to attempt the steep ascent, a figure for hard moral effort.

qen: a troop rushing in with you

en: to strike fire, to cast aspersions

qen: and those that strike sparks
note: In 100:2 it is horses striking sparks with their hooves; in modern usage القَدْح في is disparaging someone.

qen: his shirt is torn from behind
we were of divergent ways
note: Plural of قِدَّة, a path or faction; طَرائِقَ قِدَدًا means split into different sects.
